# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please report it privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/TheXTrunner/praeteritum_futurum/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities. This allows the maintainers to address the problem before it is publicly disclosed.

## Response Timeline

- You will receive a response acknowledging your report within a reasonable timeframe.
- If accepted, the vulnerability will be addressed in a future release.
- If declined, you will receive an explanation.

## Scope

This policy applies to all code and assets in this repository. Report issues such as:

- Remote code execution or arbitrary code execution
- File system access violations
- Authentication or authorization bypass
- Any other issue that could compromise player data or server security
